entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Eleven women were murdered in or near the impoverished Whitechapel district in the East End of London between 3 April 1888 and 13 February 1891. At various points, some or all of these unsolved murders have been ascribed to the notorious unidentified serial killer known as Jack the Ripper.
